registration: Track L / BIO-DIAG dynamic variable-length control registration
purpose: Register the two dynamic variable-length control extensions required by Goal V3. Neither is promoted into the 33-run CORE_PAPER_SCOPE; both are documented so their evidence boundary is explicit.

track_L.scope: learned causal dynamic chunking system reference (router / differentiable merging / differentiable token merging); a complete-system comparison, NOT part of the P1-P3 controlled patch-rule estimand
phase_3_limits: one development pilot, not three formal seeds
promotion_gates: boundary/merge decision depends only on current + historical prefix; suffix perturbation must not change observed-prefix chunk boundaries or next-step logits
source RNA recoverable losslessly via frozen encoder/decoder
mean patch length / patch count / max-cap rule freezable and auditable against P1-P3 budget
boundary/router params, training FLOPs, online inference FLOPs and latency reported separately; total params within 2% OR explicitly a complete-system reference
three independent training repetitions feasible on resources
owner signs a prospective amendment specifying added run count and permitted claims
track_L.if_not_promoted: REFERENCE_ONLY or future work; never mixed into P1-P3 controlled patch-rule contrasts

bio_diag.scope: conservation / covariation / structure-guided patching on the Rfam-alignable annotated subset only
constraints: whether it needs future/whole-sequence info reported (prefix-causality consequence)
bio_diag.evidence_boundary: diagnostic upper bound on whether biological priors could change boundary placement; NOT in broad primary ranking
bio_diag.if_promoted_later: requires train-only, family-held-out, prefix-causal boundary signal + independent re-preregistration (no silent promotion)
